cross_encoder.why: One compact discriminative baseline: a 22M-parameter BERT cross-encoder already trained for query-passage relevance (MS MARCO), fine-tuned with a new 4-way ESCI head.
cross_encoder.input: query [SEP] product_text(title, brand, colour, bullet points, description) truncated to max_length
cross_encoder.head: 4-way softmax over E/S/C/I (new, randomly initialised)
cross_encoder.training_data: both TRAIN variants (A_balanced_random, B_hard_negative), trained separately with identical settings; changed from 'the variant selected for Qwen' before any cross-encoder or Qwen validation result existed, so the baseline does not wait on ~7 h of Qwen training
cross_encoder.selection: (variant, epoch) with the highest VALIDATION macro-F1 on validation_pairs; frozen before any test evaluation
cross_encoder.ranking_score: expected gain sum_c p(c)*gain(c)/3 in place of gain/3 inside the production formula 0.8*g + 0.2*normalized RRF (pre-registered primary); the argmax-label variant is also reported
